title: Las luces · the jar at home
description: After Nuria's mission (docs/quests/nuria.md § The lights): the three lights in a glass jar on the TV unit of the Meridiana flat. Usar una luz lets one out: it rises, flies out of the balcony towards the castle and her power goes back a day. The spent one stays in the jar, dark like an empty marble, and the jar only offers a look until the next morning.

steps.caption: The jar on the TV unit, three lights lit, and the prompt Usar una luz

steps.until: (window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Bote de las luces') && window.gerard.game.app.root.find(n => n.name === 'Luz' && n.parent?.name === 'Reparto')[0])?.getPosition().y > 1.35

steps.caption: A light leaves the jar and rises

steps.until: (window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Bote de las luces') && window.gerard.game.app.root.find(n => n.name === 'Luz' && n.parent?.name === 'Reparto')[0])?.getPosition().x > window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Bote de las luces').getPosition().x + 3

steps.caption: It flies across the living room to the balcony, towards the castle
